030900Z POSITION NEAR 15.9N 80.2E.
03NOV26. TROPICAL CYCLONE 04B (MURASU), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 618
NM SOUTHWEST OF KOLKATA, INDIA, HAS TRACKED NORTH-NORTHWESTWARD
AT 03 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. ANIMATED RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED
04B MAKING LANDFALL AT AROUND 030200Z JUST NORTHEAST OF ONGOLE AS A

RAPIDLY DETERIORATE WITH INCREASINGLY DISORGANIZED CONVECTION AND
WARMING CLOUD TOP TEMPERATURES. THE SYSTEM IS FORECAST TO CONTINUE
DRIFTING SLOWLY NORTH-NORTHWESTWARD OVER THE NEXT 24 HOURS AS IT
TRACKS FURTHER INLAND. TERRAIN INTERACTION WILL FURTHER ERODE
THE COMPACT VORTEX, WITH DISSIPATION EXEPCTED TO OCCUR NO LATER THAN
TAU 24. THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING ON THIS SYSTEM BY THE JOINT TYPHOON
WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM WILL BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR
